# StartupCookie
> AI-native content & GTM agency for B2B SaaS, fintech and AI startups (also written "Startup Cookie"). Founded and run by Barbara Jovanovic. One person, maximum eight clients at a time, month-to-month programs from $5,000/mo. Next client opening: December 1st.

StartupCookie runs product marketing and product-led growth (PLG) content, thought leadership, founder LinkedIn, AEO (AI search optimization), video content, webinar repurposing, and custom GTM/content agents for seed-to-Series-B B2B companies. Most clients are fintech and finance software companies (Venn, Puzzle) or AI startups (Juno, Tofu). Founder Barbara Jovanovic runs every engagement herself; custom AI agents handle the production work. Her appearance on HubSpot's Marketing Against the Grain is the most-watched episode in the show's history (164k+ views). She returned to the show in August 2026 to walk through the Claude Code setup behind the agency.

## Case studies
